name: ResBench
description: Existing database benchmarks primarily focus on performance under ideal running environments. However, in real-world scenarios, databases probably face numerous adverse events. Quantifying the ability to cope with these events from a comprehensive perspective remains an open problem.
reputation: A very recent benchmark proposal with limited community adoption so far, aimed at evaluating database robustness under adverse real-world conditions.
notes: Focuses on database resilience rather than standard query answering; likely includes multiple failure/adversity scenarios and may not have a single universally comparable score.
